items.point: fractions as equal parts of a whole
items.rule: Equivalent fractions can be made by multiplying numerator and denominator by the same non-zero number.

items.point: fraction pieces and making a whole
items.rule: With equal denominators, the greater numerator gives the greater fraction.
A numerator equal to the denominator represents one whole.
